The New Male and Authentic Power – Internet
  • BY Gary Zukav
  • May 11, 2021
Listen now – https://storage.googleapis.com/22d-trello-assets-778459417925/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/06-17-11-The-Ultimate-Mens-Summit-Teleseminar-GaryZukav.mp3 or, use this link to download the mp3 file so you can play it later Gary Zukav on the Ultimate Men’s Summit In this amazing interview for THE ULTIMATE MEN’S SUMMIT, Gary gives both men and women an overview of the emerging New Male and New Female, what they are looking for, and how they relate. He shows how the New Male and the New Female are redefining masculinity and femininity and what that means for us. Gary speaks directly not only to the men on the teleseminar who are evolving consciously, but also to the women on the call who are interested in learning about the remarkable changes that are occurring in men.
